_note: Status 'mapped' means the component has been mapped to this criterion. It does not mean the criterion has been verified by a formal audit. Run audit-rules.json checks and update validation_status before changing overall_status.

criteria.title: Non-text Content
criteria.evidence: Card icon SVG carries aria-hidden='true'. Card icon wrapper may also carry aria-hidden='true'. The card title provides the primary accessible name via aria-labelledby on the card root. No non-text content requires a text alternative beyond the icon treatment.

criteria.title: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.evidence: Default state: text #1F2A37 on background #FFF = ~13.8:1 (passes 4.5:1 threshold). Hover state: text #1F2A37 on #F9FAFB = ~13.3:1. Focused state: same text/bg ratios. Disabled state: text #9DA4AE on #E5E7EB = ~2.1:1 — exempt per WCAG 1.4.3 exception for inactive UI components.

criteria.title: Non-text Contrast
criteria.evidence: Card border in default state: #D2D6DB on #FFF = ~1.6:1 — below 3:1 threshold for non-text contrast. This is the card container border, not a control boundary. WCAG 1.4.11 applies to UI components and graphical objects — a card container border may be exempt depending on interpretation. Manual review required.

criteria.title: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: Default type: no interactive elements in card root. Buttons inside are natively keyboard operable. Expandable type: .card__toggle is a native <button> element, operable via Enter and Space. Selectable type: checkbox is a native <input type='checkbox'>, operable via Space.

criteria.title: Focus Visible
criteria.evidence: Focus on Expandable and Selectable cards triggers :focus-within on the card root, changing border-width to 2px and border-color to #161616 (black). This provides a visible card-level focus indicator in addition to the native focus ring on the child interactive element.

criteria.title: Name, Role, Value
criteria.evidence: Card root uses role='group' with aria-labelledby pointing to .card__title. Expandable toggle: role from native <button>, name from aria-label, state from aria-expanded. Selectable checkbox: role from native <input>, name from associated <label>. Disabled state: communicated via aria-disabled='true' on card root.

standards.name: Platform Design System Internal Standards
standards._note: These are internal platform rules. IDs are stable across components. See standards/platform-code.standards.json for full definitions.

criteria.title: Component must use design tokens for all visual values
criteria.evidence: All color, spacing, radius, and font values in card.css reference --card-* CSS custom properties. All tokens include fallback values for pre-token-suite compatibility. Hardcoded value detection enforced by CARD-TOKEN-001 (error severity). Note: --card-* token suite is missing from token.css — see analysis.md Missing Tokens.

criteria.title: RTL layout support is mandatory
criteria.evidence: card.css uses flex-direction: column and does not use physical directional properties (padding-left/right, margin-left/right). RTL layout is handled by dir='rtl' on an ancestor element. Physical property detection enforced by CARD-RTL-001.

criteria.title: Semantic HTML element required for interactive variants
criteria.evidence: Card root is a <div> (non-interactive container). Toggle button uses native <button>. Checkbox uses native <input type='checkbox'>. CARD-STRUCT-001 enforces no non-interactive elements used as interactive controls.

standards.name: Platform Accessibility Internal Standards
standards._note: Accessibility-specific internal standards. See standards/accessibility.standards.json for full definitions.

criteria.title: Arabic language font support required
criteria.evidence: IBM Plex Sans Arabic applied via --card-font-family token. .card__title and .card__body inherit this token. No override to a Latin-only font present in card.css.

criteria.title: Label language must match document language context
criteria.evidence: Cannot be verified automatically. Marked for manual review. Documented in card.contract.md §11.

variant_compliance_notes.default-type: Static container. No interactive state accessibility requirements beyond grouping and icon treatment.
variant_compliance_notes.expandable-type: Requires JavaScript to toggle aria-expanded and hidden attribute. Without JS, card remains collapsed and is functional as a static card.
variant_compliance_notes.selectable-type: Requires JavaScript to sync .card--selected with checkbox checked state. Without JS, checkbox operates independently and selection visuals may not sync.
variant_compliance_notes.disabled-state: WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive UI components. Disabled state contrast #9DA4AE on #E5E7EB (~2.1:1) is intentionally below threshold and compliant per the exemption.
variant_compliance_notes.card-border-contrast: Default border #D2D6DB on #FFF = ~1.6:1. Below WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 threshold for non-text contrast. Whether a card container border is a 'UI component' per WCAG 1.4.11 requires manual legal review. Consider increasing border contrast in a future token update.
